full_prompt_en: A square, closely cropped portrait image shows a young woman in three-quarter profile against a nearly black blue-gray background. Her face occupies the upper and central area, angled downward to the right, with lowered eyes and lips gently parted. Loose, wavy light hair frames her forehead and cheek; one curling strand reaches into the dark space along the right edge. The facial surface is rendered in a restrained near-monochrome range of pale gray, cool blue-gray, and charcoal, with soft transitions around the eyelids, nose, and mouth. Fine lashes, a sharply defined nose bridge, and the subtle texture of the skin remain more precise than the low-detail background. Around her neck and shoulders, a thick dark scarf wraps in layered folds. A deep rusty red section runs diagonally from the lower left across the chest, the only vivid color in the image, while another portion retains cooler navy shadow. The garment below falls into near-black, allowing the red textile and luminous face to carry most of the visual weight. No setting is visible beyond the smooth dark field, and the close framing cuts off the top of the hair and the body beneath the shoulders. Soft light from above and slightly left brushes the forehead, eyelid, cheek, and edge of the nose, then fades across the far side of the face into shadow. The scarf's woven texture appears coarser and more tactile than the smooth facial modeling. The overall composition rests on a downward, inward gaze and one concentrated red accent, creating a quiet, intimate mood within deep cool darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形近裁肖像图像呈现一位年轻女子的四分之三侧脸，背后是近黑的蓝灰色背景。面孔占据上方与中央区域，朝右下低垂，眼睛下望，嘴唇轻轻分开。松散微卷的浅色头发围住额头和脸颊，一缕卷发伸入右缘深暗空间。面部表面以克制的近单色浅灰、冷蓝灰和炭黑表现，眼睑、鼻子与嘴周有柔和过渡。细睫毛、明确的鼻梁和微妙的皮肤纹理比缺少细节的背景更精确。厚重深色围巾绕过颈肩，折成多层褶皱。一段深锈红色从左下斜越胸前，是画面唯一鲜明的色彩，另一部分则保留较冷的藏蓝阴影。下方衣服沉入近黑，使红色织物和发亮的面部承载大部分视觉重量。平滑暗色场之外看不见具体环境，近景取框截去头发顶部和肩下身体。柔光从上方略偏左掠过额头、眼睑、面颊和鼻缘，随后在脸另一侧逐渐退入阴影。围巾织纹比平滑面部塑形更粗、更可触。整体构图依靠向下收拢的目光和一处集中的红色强调，在深冷黑暗中形成安静亲密的情绪。
style_prompt_en: The image relies on a near-monochrome cool tonal field interrupted by one compact, saturated warm accent. Pale gray focal planes emerge gradually from blue-black surroundings, with delicate modeling and only a few crisp edges at the point of attention. Dense charcoal shadow swallows peripheral detail, and a coarser woven or granular passage contrasts with smoother central surfaces. Soft light from above and one side shapes volume without producing hard cast shadows or glossy shine. Close framing and generous dark space create intimacy, while the warm accent holds the lower composition. The overall treatment is subdued, tactile, and introspective.
style_prompt_zh: 图像依靠近单色的冷调色域，并由一处紧凑饱和的暖色强调打断。浅灰焦点平面从蓝黑环境中渐渐显现，塑形细腻，只有注意力所在处的少数边缘清楚。浓重炭黑阴影吞没外围细节，较粗的织物或颗粒段落与平滑中央表面形成对照。柔光从上方一侧塑造体积，没有硬投影或光滑闪亮。贴近的取框和宽阔暗处形成亲密感，暖色点稳住下方构图。整体处理低调、可触而内省。
theme_en: A contemplative close portrait with a deep red scarf
theme_zh: 佩着深红围巾的沉思近景肖像
name: Desaturated colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
